description:
Every weapon's damage, DPS, fire rate, magazine, reload and range. The data behind https://rust.wiki/weapons: every gun, bow, launcher and main melee weapon with `damage` per
bullet/pellet (standard ammo), `pellets` (shotguns), `hit` (damage x pellets), raw `dps` (hit x `rpm` / 60 -
ignores reloads, recoil, armour and falloff), `magazine`, `reload_s`, `range_m` (damage falloff start-end) /
`range_end`, `ammo`, `workbench` (level to craft; null = loot only, 0 = no bench) and `notes`. Checked against
Facepunch's wiki and patch notes (`sources`, `verified`); Facepunch rebalances weapons often.

search.description: Case-insensitive match on the weapon name.

sort.description: Sort key: highest first, except `name` and `reload_s` (lowest first).
